basis: Sale consideration: Remedy Partners, a BCV company from 2015 (its own row, remedy-partners), combined with Signify Health in 2019, and Signify's IPO registration files the investor rights agreement with Bain Capital Venture Fund 2014, L.P. signing beside Remedy Founders LLC among the former Remedy holders. The firm's 2022 listing reflects that stock; no source shows new BCV money in Signify. Stock received because a company bought a portfolio company is not membership, and the acquirer leaves the base (COLLECTION.md s1, Erik 2026-09-22).
